firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: signature visible at 0% (20-tie track, TODAY WK 06 marker), one amber primary + outlined secondary, phone in header and hero, Sample-labelled proof line. But the h1 'Week 1 to week 20. A report every Friday.' is 9 words and names neither trade nor city (both live only in the mono eyebrow) (-0.5); the next band peeks ~15px, under the 40px floor (-0.5, offset by the signature in frame); proof line floats ~90px below the buttons with dead space. 390-first.jpg: h1 4 lines, both actions above the fold, mobile bar present; no next-band peek.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: crosstie signature in hero track, pinned story (WK 01/03/06/18 ties), the '20 ties' break, service rails, review card tie-heads, timeline-builder output and the 'WK 20 END OF TRACK' footer plate. It organises information (story, break, tool), not just decorates. gA3 sibling check (general B ledger sheet, C contour map): no shared face, hero family or palette. Held back from 9.5 by AI tells: mono micro-labels on almost every block and decorative 01/02/03 numbering in promise, services (01-08), reviews (01-06) and contact steps (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg).

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Barlow Condensed display with a real scale-contrast moment ('20 TIES. 20 FRIDAYS. ONE HOUSE.'), Work Sans body at full ink, DM Mono tabular prices and hours with en-dash ranges. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: one view holds SHEET 03, FOOTING SECTION, WK 06, DONE, TODAY, WALLS BEAMS ROOF FRAMING, NEXT, FROM YOU, SHEET 06, WALL FRAMING: 3+ tiny tracked caps labels (-0.5). Hero tie numbers and report thumb captions set at .6875rem (11px), under 13px (1440-first.jpg bottom track).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 12 sections, tones alternate dark/paper/dark/mid/paper/dark/amber/paper/dark/paper/dark/amber with no two same tones touching; full-bleed break, asymmetric pinned story, dense cost ledger, quiet live-in checklist. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: right column under each report list is empty for ~200px per tie, acceptable. 390-full.jpg: six full review cards stack to ~1900px, the longest run on the phone.

photo.notes: No stock frames; drawn plates only (footer: 'Drawings made for this sample site'). 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-full.jpg: one line-weight, one grid, one amber accent across hero elevation, SHEET 01/03/06/18 plates and report thumbnails, so it reads as one set; the sheets tell a plan to work to result sequence and carry the signature. Nothing broken or blank. Not 9.5: the hero elevation is a generic gable house that any GC could use.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: concrete trade nouns (dust walls, sill plate, doubled header, rough-in, punch list), honest 'Real tracks are written after we walk the house', every review/price/rating/guarantee/licence Sample-labelled. Primary action has several names: 'Price an addition' (1440-first.jpg), 'Get a number' (390-first.jpg bar), 'Price this job' (1440-scroll-50.jpg), 'Get my real track', 'Get my number' (1440-full.jpg) (-0.5). The Done / Next / From you trio is explained three times (promise, story rows, report tabs).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 4 lines, both CTAs above fold, sticky call + 'Get a number' bar. 390-full.jpg: story becomes stacked ties with no pin, checklist and ZIP tools single-column with large targets, form options full-width rows. Weak spots: 6 review cards stacked in full (~1900px), and the hero track's 01 label is clipped at the left edge.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: every section, story tie, report card, tool and review visible with reduced motion. render.json: no errors, no overflow at 320 or 390. dist headings: one h1, h2 per section, h3 under them, no skips. Forced-colors and print media present.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: amber today-line scrubbed down the rail to the WK 06 tie, which carries its DONE stamp while the line keeps moving; the story explains order. Timeline builder bars stagger as a Gantt (1440-full.jpg). Hover language: one hairline under links. Not 9.5: the hero track itself is static after the intro and the today-line uses a glow box-shadow.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg + 1440-full.jpg: the today-line crossing ties and stamping DONE is the thesis in motion, and the 'How long will mine take?' output (20 weeks, phase bars, Sample timeline) is a tool a homeowner would keep. Not 10: the tool output is a plain bar chart, not drawn as ties on the track.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: radius held at 1-2px, consistent rules, designed footer close with the WK 20 plate, print stylesheet present. The Friday report card in the amber band carries a drop shadow (0 18px 40px) on a non-floating element (-0.5); the today-line has an amber glow.

elevate.move: Make the h1 itself say trade and place on the track: lead with the outcome and city as the week count ('Nashville additions, week 1 to week 20.'), and pull the proof line up so it sits on the hero tie like a spike plate. Then lift the hero track so the paper band peeks 60-80px below it, with the signature as the threshold into the next section.

Cut the mono label system down to one job: DM Mono only for week numbers and figures. Set phase names and sheet titles in Barlow Condensed at a single small size, and drop every tracked-caps sub-label that repeats the heading. Then the stencilled week numbers become the only small type voice, and nothing on the page is under 13px.
